# TripToCost

> TripToCost publishes complete, ready-to-go travel itineraries: day-by-day plans, culture guides, packing checklists, and insider tips for 121 destinations across the world. Every itinerary assumes Day 1 begins with airport arrival, states a real estimated budget upfront, and includes a "Need to Know" culture/etiquette section and a printable packing list.

## Seasonal guides
- [Christmas Markets](https://triptocost.com/christmas-markets): 14 itineraries, prices per person
- [Winter Sun](https://triptocost.com/winter-sun-destinations): 15 itineraries, prices per person
- [Winter Trips](https://triptocost.com/winter-trips): 10 itineraries, prices per person
- [Autumn Trips](https://triptocost.com/autumn-trips): 8 itineraries, prices per person

- [Browse all destinations](https://triptocost.com/browse): filterable list of every itinerary by travel style, budget, and region

- [How It Works](https://triptocost.com/how-it-works): what's included in every itinerary guide
- [Saved Trips](https://triptocost.com/saved-trips): a visitor's bookmarked itineraries (stored locally in their browser only)
